declaration: Pre-registered audit declaration. Written and hashed before any model state was scored on this panel. Every field below is a commitment, not a description of results.
written_at_step: before scoring; see README.md for the sha256 recorded at that time

panel.name: LAMBADA-OpenAI test
panel.records_used: all records in the file, unfiltered, in file order
panel.audit_unit: one LAMBADA passage (one JSONL record). Tokens within a passage are dependent; the passage is the independent unit and n is the record count, never the token count.

targets.definition: loss(z) = mean over the BPE tokens of the passage's final word of -ln q(token | prefix), where q = (1-alpha)*p_model + alpha/V
targets.masking_policy: context = text.rsplit(' ',1)[0]; scored continuation = ' ' + final word; only continuation positions are scored

targets.definition: loss(z) = mean over every token of the passage at positions 1..T-1 of -ln q(token | prefix), same floored quote
targets.masking_policy: position 0 has no left context and is excluded; every other token of the passage is scored

targets.definition: as Q1, under the GPT-NeoX BPE tokenizer and the Pythia softmax width
as Q2, under the GPT-NeoX BPE tokenizer and the Pythia softmax width

cross_target_rule: Q1/Q2 (GPT-2 BPE) and Q3/Q4 (NeoX BPE) tokenise the same strings differently, so per-token levels are NOT comparable across families. Levels and gains are reported within a target only. The discrimination ratio is dimensionless and is the only quantity compared across families.

quote_construction.form: q = (1 - alpha) * p_model + alpha * u,  u = uniform over the model's softmax width V
quote_construction.reference_quote: p_ref = u, the uniform code over the same V. It is model-independent, it is the no-knowledge code on the declared label set, and its floored form equals itself, so L_Q(p_ref) = ln V exactly on every unit.

slack.N_rule: N = the number of distinct model states scored on that target's panel. Q1,Q2: N=2 (gpt2, gpt2-medium). Q3,Q4: N=4 (pythia-160m at step1000, step16000, step64000, step143000).
slack.route_c_justification_to_be_checked: all five steering channels must be answered False for each family before route (c) is computed; a route (d) sensitivity is reported regardless

reported_without_selection: All four targets are reported for both comparisons with equal prominence. No target, metric, alpha or state pair is chosen after seeing a number. If any reported lower bound is non-positive it is reported as non-positive.
auxiliary_metrics_not_used_in_the_bound: unfloored per-word negative log likelihood of the final word, whose exponentiated mean reproduces the published LAMBADA perplexity
teacher-forced greedy exact match on the final word, which reproduces the published LAMBADA accuracy
